description_en: Initiates a session with a specified DataAgent and receives the agent's replies, execution processes, and artifacts in real time as an event stream. Multiple rounds of Q&A within the same session thread share the context. This operation can be used to append questions to an existing conversation, reconnect to an unfinished streaming output, or terminate an ongoing reply generation
description_zh: 与指定的 DataAgent 发起一次会话，并以事件流的方式实时接收 Agent 的回复、执行过程与产物。同一会话线程内的多轮问答共享上下文，可用于在已有对话中追加提问、重新连接尚未结束的流式输出，或终止正在生成的回复
kebab_example: aliyun sls create-chat --name my-agent --thread-id thread-tiirv9-irwdoal8t4rm --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateChat

parameters.help_en:
The action type of the current request. Valid values:
create (default): Initiates a new round of conversation.
reconnect: Reconnects to an unfinished conversation in the current thread to continue receiving the output.
stop: Terminates the ongoing reply generation
parameters.help_zh:
本次请求的动作类型。取值：
create（默认）：发起新一轮对话。
reconnect：重新连接到当前线程尚未结束的对话，继续接收输出。
stop：终止正在生成的回复
parameters.name: action

fields.help_en: The content type. Set this parameter to text for text content
fields.help_zh: 内容类型。文本内容填 text
fields.name: type

fields.example: 统计最近 1 小时 nginx-access-log 中请求量最高的 10 个 URL
fields.help_en: The content value. When type is set to text, this parameter specifies the question text sent to the agent
fields.help_zh: 内容值。当 type 为 text 时，为发送给 Agent 的问题文本
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The list of message contents. A single message can carry multiple content segments
fields.help_zh: 消息内容列表，支持一条消息携带多段内容
fields.name: contents

fields.help_en: The message ID generated by the caller to identify this message in the current request
fields.help_zh: 消息 ID，由调用方生成，用于标识本次请求中的这条消息
fields.name: message_id

fields.help_en: The sender of the message. Set this parameter to user for user questions
fields.help_zh: 消息的发送方。用户提问填 user
fields.name: role

fields.help_en: The list of tool interaction results. When the agent requires you to confirm or supplement input on the client side through an interactive event, backfill the corresponding interaction results in the next request
fields.help_zh: 工具交互结果列表。当 Agent 通过 interactive 事件要求您在客户端侧确认或补充输入时，在下一次请求中回填对应的交互结果
fields.name: tools

parameters.help_en: The list of messages carried in the current request. When initiating a new conversation, a message with the role user is typically passed. This parameter is optional when action is set to reconnect or stop
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求携带的消息列表。发起新对话时通常传入一条 role 为 user 的消息；action 为 reconnect 或 stop 时可以不传
parameters.name: messages

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent, which specifies the agent for the current session. The agent must be created under the current account and you must have the permissions to access it
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的名称，指定本次会话对话的 Agent。必须是当前账号下已创建、且您有权限访问的 Agent
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The session thread ID, which identifies a continuous conversation context. Multiple rounds of Q&A within the same thread share the context. You must first call CreateThread to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh: 会话线程 ID，标识一次连续的对话上下文，同一线程内的多轮问答共享上下文。需先调用 CreateThread 获取
parameters.name: thread_id

parameters.help_en: The session variables in key-value pairs, which are used to pass context parameters for the current session to the agent, such as workspace, region, project, language, timeZone, startTime, and endTime. You can omit unnecessary keys
parameters.help_zh: 会话变量，键值对形式，用于向 Agent 传入本次会话的上下文参数，例如工作空间（workspace）、地域（region）、Project、语言（language）、时区（timeZone）、起止时间（startTime、endTime）等。不需要的键可以省略
parameters.name: variables

schema.description_en: The response. This operation returns a Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream with the Content-Type set to text/event-stream. The data field of each event is a JSON document of the following structure, which is pushed multiple times while the agent generates the reply
schema.description_zh: 返回结果。本接口以 Server-Sent Events 流（Content-Type: text/event-stream）返回，每个事件的 data 字段都是下述结构的一个 JSON 文档，会在 Agent 生成回复的过程中多次推送

messages.description_en: The list of messages pushed in the current event. Typically, this list contains only one newly added message
messages.description_zh: 本次事件推送的消息列表，通常只包含一条本次新增的消息

agents.description_en: The list of sub-agent calls initiated in the current message. This field may appear only when role is set to assistant
agents.description_zh: 本条消息中发起的子 Agent 调用列表，仅 role 为 assistant 时可能出现

additionalProperties.description_en: The sub-agent invocation details. Common fields include name (the name of the sub-agent), arguments (the input parameters for the current invocation), and status (the execution status: start, progress, success, or fail)
additionalProperties.description_zh: 子 Agent 调用明细，常见字段为 name（子 Agent 名称）、arguments（本次调用的入参）、status（执行状态：start、progress、success、fail）

items.description_en: The information about a sub-agent call
items.description_zh: 一次子 Agent 调用的信息

artifacts.description_en: The list of artifacts (files) generated by the current message. This field may appear only when role is set to assistant
artifacts.description_zh: 本条消息产出的产物（文件）列表，仅 role 为 assistant 时可能出现

additionalProperties.description_en: The artifact details. Common fields include name (the artifact name) and path (the artifact path). You can call operations such as ListArtifacts and GetArtifact to retrieve the generated files
additionalProperties.description_zh: 产物明细，常见字段为 name（产物名称）、path（产物路径）等。可通过 ListArtifacts、GetArtifact 等接口获取已产出的文件

callId.description_en: The call ID of the current execution. A message with this value as its parentCallId is its subordinate message. This field can be used to restore the execution hierarchy of the agent
callId.description_zh: 本次执行的调用标识。以该值为 parentCallId 的消息即为它的下级消息，可用于还原 Agent 的执行层级

contents.description_en: The list of contents in the current message

additionalProperties.description_en: The content details. Common fields include type and value. If type is text, value is the reply text snippet. If type is spin_text, value is the prompts for the thinking and execution process of the agent. If type is thread_title_updated, value is the updated conversation title. If type is error, value is the error message that contains a code and a message. During streaming output, the append (whether it is an incremental snippet) and lastChunk (whether it is the last chunk) markers are also included
additionalProperties.description_zh: 内容明细。常见字段为 type 与 value：type 为 text 时 value 是回复文本片段；type 为 spin_text 时 value 是 Agent 的思考与执行过程提示；type 为 thread_title_updated 时 value 是更新后的会话标题；type 为 error 时 value 是包含 code 与 message 的错误信息。流式输出时还带有 append（是否为增量片段）与 lastChunk（是否为最后一段）标记

detail.description_en: The supplementary description of the current message, such as the description of the action currently being executed
detail.description_zh: 本条消息的补充说明，例如当前正在执行的动作描述

events.description_en: The list of events carried in the current message, which indicates changes in the session state. Common types include: thinking (the agent is thinking), interactive (additional input or confirmation is required), task_finished (the current node is completed, and the payload contains success and statistics information), stream_done (the current streaming output is completed), error (an execute fault occurred), and thread_title_updated (the session title is updated)
events.description_zh: 本条消息携带的事件列表，用于表达会话状态的变化。常见 type：thinking（思考中）、interactive（需要您补充输入或确认）、task_finished（本次任务结束，payload 中带有 success 与统计信息）、stream_done（本次流式输出结束）、error（执行出错）、thread_title_updated（会话标题更新）

additionalProperties.description_en: The event details. Common fields include type (the event type) and payload (the event data, whose structure varies depending on the event type)
additionalProperties.description_zh: 事件明细，常见字段为 type（事件类型）与 payload（事件数据，结构随事件类型不同而不同）

parentCallId.description_en: The ID of the parent call, which is used to restore the execution hierarchy. An empty string indicates the root node of the current session
parentCallId.description_zh: 父调用的标识，用于还原执行层级。取值为空字符串时表示本次会话的根节点

role.description_en: The producer of the message. Valid values: assistant (the reply or action of the agent), tool (the tool execution result), user (the user input), and system (the system message)
role.description_zh: 消息的产生方。取值：assistant（Agent 的回复或动作）、tool（工具执行结果）、user（用户输入）、system（系统消息）

seq.description_en: The message sequence number, which increments within the same session and can be used to sort messages at the same level. We recommend that you also refer to timestamp instead of strictly relying on this value
seq.description_zh: 消息序号，在同一次会话中递增，可用于同级消息排序。建议同时参考 timestamp，不要强依赖该值

timestamp.description_en: The time when the message was generated. The value is a UNIX timestamp in string format
timestamp.description_zh: 消息生成时间，Unix 时间戳，字符串形式

tools.description_en: The list of invoke for tool calling initiated by the agent in the current message. This field may appear only when role is set to assistant
tools.description_zh: 本条消息中 Agent 发起的工具调用列表，仅 role 为 assistant 时可能出现

additionalProperties.description_en: The tool calling details. Common fields include name (the tool name), arguments (the input parameters to invoke), status (the execute stage status: start, success, or fail), state (the execute result: success or fail), and contents (the tool output content)
additionalProperties.description_zh: 工具调用明细，常见字段为 name（工具名称）、arguments（入参）、status（执行阶段状态：start、success、fail）、state（执行结果：success、fail）、contents（工具输出内容）

type.description_en: The message type. This field may be absent for regular reply messages. It appears when the entire message is used to express a state, such as done indicating the end of the session and error indicating an error message
type.description_zh: 消息类型。常规回复消息可以没有该字段；当整条消息用于表达状态时会出现，例如 done 表示会话结束、error 表示错误消息

version.description_en: The version number of the message structure. The current version is v0.1.0
version.description_zh: 消息结构版本号，当前为 v0.1.0

traceId.description_en: The Tracing Analysis ID of the current session, which is used to locate the current invoke during troubleshooting
traceId.description_zh: 本次会话的链路追踪 ID，用于在问题排查时定位本次调用

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body in JSON format
v1_body_parameters.name: body
